title: Mac idle → panel only, never withheld

setup.note: The same artifact, with the last screen event 20 minutes old. The user is not at the Mac, so there is no card — and NOTHING else changes. The router has no hold state.

expected.note: Routing the same set at the Mac and away from it differs by the card and by nothing else. router_withheld = 0.
